text: Now, maybe those controls all are there and are just condtional and NEVER render, maybe thats very true, IDK. im just trying to get us on the same page
resolution: Established shared audit terminology: registry-defined, statically render-reachable, and observed-visible are separate claims. The disputed Add Chunk/Trigger/Spawn/Compile controls are registry-defined and statically reachable through ToolOptions' active-menu branch, but are not observed in the user's Section D screenshot; therefore they must not be described as currently visible Section D controls without a named/reproduced state. The screenshot's Build-state inventory is the visual authority. No code changed.
